prompt: Implement cache_trace(addresses, line_bytes=16, set_count=2, ways=1), a declared cold read-allocating cache and reference-cache analyzer. It is not real CPU/cache simulation, hardware profiling or a multi-level cache. addresses is a native list of 0–64 native integer BYTE addresses in 0..4095. line_bytes is one of 1,2,4,8,16; set_count is one of 1,2,4,8; ways is a native int 1–4. Every int excludes bool. Each address demands one byte. Block=a//line_bytes, set=block%set_count, tag=block//set_count. The actual cache has set_count sets with ways slots each. Each set starts empty and uses LRU: lists are ordered least to most recently used. Every demand looks up its block, then makes that block most recently used. A miss always fetches one full line directly from DRAM, evicts the least-recent block only if that set is full, and allocates the requested block. Each fill completes before the next demand; no bypass, prefetch, writes/writebacks, invalidation, coalescing or concurrent traffic. In parallel maintain a HYPOTHETICAL fully associative LRU reference of capacity set_count*ways lines, initially empty, processing EVERY same demand with the same read-allocation policy; its analysis creates no additional physical DRAM traffic. Determine both actual and reference hits BEFORE either update. Classify the actual demand as 'hit' if it hits actual cache, even if the reference misses; otherwise 'compulsory' if this block has never appeared in the call, 'conflict' if it has appeared and the reference hits, or 'capacity' if it has appeared and the reference misses. Then update both caches and the seen-block set. Return exactly {hits,misses,compulsory,conflict,capacity,transferred_bytes,cache,reference,trace}. Counts and transferred_bytes are native ints; transferred_bytes counts only actual misses times line_bytes. cache is the final list of per-set block-ID lists in set-index order, each LRU-to-MRU; reference is the final LRU-to-MRU block-ID list. trace contains one exact record per input address in order: {address,block,set,tag,hit,reference_hit,classification,evicted,cache,reference}. address/block/set/tag are native ints, hit/reference_hit native bools, classification a string above, evicted the actual evicted block ID or None. The trace caches are snapshots AFTER that demand; reference_hit is the pre-update reference lookup. A hit or a miss into an unfilled set has evicted=None. Empty input returns zero counts, empty trace/reference, and set_count distinct empty cache rows. All containers/scalars have exactly the stated built-in dict/list/str/int/bool/None types. Inputs satisfy the complete domain; no invalid-input validation is required. Never mutate inputs, including during later calls. Every returned mutable container, including all snapshot rows and final caches, must be fresh, pairwise independent and disjoint from every input and earlier result. Earlier output values and native types remain unchanged through later calls. Use only the standard library and ordinary computation/allocation, with no real hardware/compiler/runtime invocation, raw memory, threads or network.

Implement predictor_trace(entry_count, events, initial_state=1), a declared tagless indexed two-bit predictor model, not Intel hardware simulation. entry_count is a native int in 1..16, excluding bool. initial_state is a native int in 0..3, default 1; every entry initially has that state. events is a native list of 0..128 exact dicts {pc,taken}; pc is a native int in 0..65535 and taken is a native bool. PCs are opaque nonnegative byte addresses; no alignment restriction applies. Index each event by (pc//4)%entry_count. Process events in input order. Save before=states[index], predict taken exactly when before>=2, and assess mismatch against that SAVED pre-update prediction. Then update only this counter to min(3,before+1) on taken or max(0,before-1) on not-taken. There are no tags, history hashes, speculative updates, resets or skipped training. Distinct PCs can alias. Return an exact native dict {states,mispredictions,trace}: states is the final native list of entry_count native ints; mispredictions is the native int total; trace is a native list in event order of exact dicts {pc,index,taken,prediction,before,after,misprediction}. pc/index/before/after are exact native ints; taken/prediction/misprediction are exact native bools. Empty events returns initialized states, zero total and an empty trace. All containers and scalars must have exact built-in dict/list/str/int/bool types; bool does not substitute for int. Every returned mutable container must be distinct from every input container, every other returned container and every earlier call's result containers. Inputs, including their native types, must remain unchanged during this and later calls. Earlier returned values and their native types must remain unchanged during later calls. Inputs satisfy all schemas and bounds; outside-domain validation is not required. Use only standard-library computation/allocation, with no actual hardware, compiler, benchmark, thread, process or network execution inside the candidate. The checker runs the candidate in a subprocess with a five-second timeout.

Implement resource_reports(cases), a pure exact-rational batch model with no real runtime, hardware or compiler invocation. cases is a native list of 0–12 native dicts. Required keys are serial, parallel, workers, flops, dram_bytes, compute_peak, bandwidth; optional overhead defaults to [0,1], and no other keys are present. Each time/rate field serial, parallel, overhead, compute_peak, bandwidth is a native two-int list [numerator,denominator], with numerator in 0..1000000 and denominator in 1..1000000; input pairs need not be reduced. compute_peak and bandwidth numerators are positive; serial and parallel are not both zero. workers is a native int 1..64; flops and dram_bytes are native ints 1..1000000. Every integer domain excludes bool. Times use one common abstract time unit; peak is FLOPs/time-unit, bandwidth is DRAM bytes/time-unit, and dram_bytes is the same kernel's actual DRAM traffic after cache filtering. For each case let Ts,Tp,O,N,W,Q,P,B denote these values. Compute T1=Ts+Tp, Tc=Ts+Tp/N, To=Tc+O, s=Ts/T1 and alpha=Ts/Tc. Return one exact dict {parallel,roofline} per case, in input order. parallel has exactly baseline_time=T1, ideal_parallel_time=Tc, parallel_time_with_overhead=To, baseline_serial_fraction=s, ideal_parallel_serial_fraction=alpha, amdahl_speedup=T1/Tc, gustafson_speedup=N-(N-1)*alpha, speedup_with_overhead=T1/To, efficiency_with_overhead=(T1/To)/N. Gustafson therefore uses the ideal parallel-run fraction for this SAME work and equals the ideal fixed-work speedup. Do not put O into alpha or compare that ideal result to the overhead-charged result as if their assumptions matched. roofline has exactly operational_intensity=I=W/Q, performance_ceiling=min(P,B*I), time_lower_bound=max(W/P,Q/B), limiting_resource='compute' if P<B*I, 'memory' if P>B*I, otherwise 'tie'. These are separate declared calculations, not proof that the ideal decomposition achieves the resource bound. Do not add the panels' times or insert O into the kernel-only Roofline result. No cross-model physical-consistency validation is required. Every numeric output must be a fresh canonical reduced rational pair [num,den] of native ints, with den>0, gcd(num,den)=1, and zero=[0,1]. Derived numerators and denominators are not restricted by the input bounds. Only limiting_resource is a string. Return a native list of reports; empty input returns []. All containers/scalars have the stated exact built-in dict/list/str/int types. Inputs meet the complete domain, so no outside-domain validation is required. Preserve all inputs and earlier output values/types through later calls. Every returned mutable container must be distinct from all inputs, other returned containers and earlier results. Use only the standard library and ordinary Python computation/allocation, with no network, raw memory, threads or external runtime/compiler invocation.

Implement stack_attribution(samples), a deterministic unit-weight supplied-stack analyzer, not a real profiler or causal bottleneck detector. samples is a native list of 0–64 samples; each sample is a NONEMPTY native list of 1–16 frame-ID strings ordered caller/root to currently executing leaf. Across one call at most 32 distinct IDs occur. IDs are case-sensitive ASCII strings matching [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,15}; they identify aggregated frame labels, so recursive repeated IDs within a sample are valid. Records are accurately labeled inputs to this model, but no wall-time, uniform-sampling or true-population assumption is inferred. Let n=len(samples). Count inclusive(frame) ONCE per sample containing that ID, regardless of recursive duplicates. Count self(frame) only when it is the LAST ID of a sample. Include every observed frame, including ancestors with self=0. Return exactly {sample_count,frames,majority_hotspot}. sample_count is native int n. frames is a native list sorted by ascending ASCII frame ID, with each row exactly {frame,inclusive,self,inclusive_fraction,self_fraction}. Counts are native ints, excluding bool. For n>0, each fraction is a fresh canonical reduced two-int list count/n, denominator positive and zero represented [0,1]. majority_hotspot is the unique frame ID with self count STRICTLY greater than n/2, or None when no such frame exists, including ties and n=0. This means only an observed leaf-sample majority/ranking: it is not proof of true CPU fraction, wall-latency dominance or which optimization helps most. Empty input returns {sample_count:0,frames:[],majority_hotspot:None}. Individual empty stacks are outside the domain. Preserve caller/leaf order when interpreting a sample; sorting output does not permit sorting input stacks before identifying leaves. All inputs satisfy the schema, so no invalid-input validation is required. All containers/scalars have exact built-in dict/list/str/int types, plus None for an absent majority. Every returned mutable container must be fresh and distinct from inputs, other returned containers and earlier results. All input and prior output values/types remain unchanged through later calls. Use only the standard library and ordinary Python computation/allocation; no real profiler, runtime/compiler invocation, raw memory, threads or network.

Implement abba_measurements(base_a, base_b, drift, trials, resolution=1), a declared exact noiseless cost/quantizer analyzer, not JMH, physical-clock or hardware execution. A and B implement the same verified logical operation with matching timing boundaries. At abstract trial position i, true per-operation cost is base_variant+drift*i and is constant within that trial. Drift is per INDEX POSITION, not per wall-clock timestamp. base_a/base_b are native ints in 1..1000000; drift is a native int in -1000..1000. All four chosen costs for A0,B1,B2,A3 must be at least 1. trials is a native list of exactly four native dicts in fixed ABBA order, each exactly {start,operations}. start is a native int in 0..10**12; operations is a native int in 1..10000 and denotes actual completed operations, not an unchecked reporting annotation. True elapsed_i=operations_i*(base_variant+drift*i); end_i=start_i+elapsed_i must be <=10**12. Trials are ordered and nonoverlapping: each next start is at least the preceding end; gaps are allowed. There is no setup, fixed per-invocation overhead, failure or other work. resolution is a native int in 1..1000000, default 1. All integer inputs exclude bool. The monotonic nonwrapping integer timestamp model is q(t)=resolution*(t//resolution). For each trial measured_i=q(end_i)-q(start_i) and error_i=measured_i-elapsed_i. A positive true interval can have measured duration zero. Return an exact native dict {trials,mean_a,mean_b,measured_ratio,same_position_ratio,time_zero_ratio}. Output trials is a fresh list of four exact dicts {variant,position,elapsed,measured,error,per_op}: variant is native str A/B; position/elapsed/measured/error are native ints; per_op is native float measured_i/operations_i. mean_a is the unweighted arithmetic mean of per_op for indices 0,3; mean_b is the unweighted mean for indices 1,2. Both are native floats. Normalize EACH trial BEFORE averaging; do not pool unequal operation counts. measured_ratio is native float mean_a/mean_b when mean_b>0 and None otherwise, including 0/0. A zero numerator with positive denominator yields 0.0. same_position_ratio is native float (base_a+1.5*drift)/(base_b+1.5*drift), the true normalized ABBA mean ratio at common position 1.5. time_zero_ratio is separately native float base_a/base_b. Quantization may make measured_ratio differ from both true ratios; balancing does not in general recover the time-zero ratio. Every float must be finite; numerical comparison uses relative and absolute tolerance 1e-12. No variance, tail, stationarity or universal speedup inference is required. Exact built-in dict/list/str/int/float/None types are required in their stated fields. Every returned mutable container must be distinct from every input, every other returned container and every earlier call's result containers. Inputs and their native types remain unchanged during this and later calls; earlier returned values and their native types remain unchanged during later calls. All supplied inputs satisfy the domain, so outside-domain validation is not required. Use only standard-library computation/allocation, with no actual hardware, compiler, benchmark, thread, process or network execution inside the candidate. The checker runs the candidate in a subprocess with a five-second timeout.
